subject: Post-call recap — Redwood integration and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acmetech.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmetech.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — Redwood integration and next steps
Attachments: redwood-integration-diagram.png, SOW-draft.docx

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Summary of pain points you mentioned:
- Latency spikes on customer-facing generative features during peak traffic (esp. product search and suggestions)
- High per-token costs when re-ranking detailed candidate lists for personalized results
- Difficulty maintaining consistent behavior across hosted and on-prem environments (compliance reqs)

Goals we heard:
- Consistent p95 latency <= 300ms for short responses (<=256 tokens)
- Cost reduction of ~30% on re-ranking workloads via batching/quantization/caching
- Ability to run inference in a private VPC for regulated user datasets

Integration & product fit notes (from today’s discussion):
- SDK changes: you’ll embed the Redwood JS/py SDK into the search service; we support a lightweight async client that preserves streaming and function-calling semantics.
- Function calling: recommend mapping your structured product metadata to function schemas; Redwood’s function-calling preserves typed JSON outputs which should let you avoid additional parsing logic.
- Streaming: we can stream token-by-token to your frontend; this will be useful for your instant suggestions UI.
- Structured outputs: use Redwood’s validation hooks to enforce schema-level constraints on model responses (e.g., product_id, score, category).
- Embeddings & re-ranking: propose using semantic embeddings + approximate nearest-neighbor index for candidate retrieval and then a reranker on top (we can serve both components from Dedicated pools for throughput).

Next steps (proposed timeline):
1) Redwood SE deep-dive + demo (function calling + streaming + reranker) — target week of May 24. (Vivek to lead demo)
2) Tech Q&A: share your SSO/KMS and network requirements; we’ll map to Private/Dedicated options. (Acme to share SSR doc)
3) Draft SOW & pricing estimate — we’ll send initial SOW for review by May 21.
4) Pilot kickoff: 4–6 week pilot on dedicated pool + evaluation prompts.

Action items from me:
- I attached a high-level integration diagram and a SOW draft for your review.
- I’ll schedule the SE demo (Vivek) and include a capacity & pricing estimate (Rishi).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap, this is exactly the posture we need. A couple quick items from our side: 

- Confirmed: we want p95 latency targets for search suggestions and an initial focus on the re-ranking flow (low latency + cost reduction).
- We’ll send our SSO/KMS/Network SSRs (attached) by EOD Monday.
- For the SE demo, we’d like the session to include a short preview of the SDK integration (code-level), function-calling examples for structured product output, and an example re-ranking pipeline using embeddings. Our engineering manager (Sarah) will be on the call.

Could you also include an initial pricing ballpark for a 3-month pilot (reserved Dedicated capacity) and any minimum contract terms? If possible, include options for both Dedicated and Private (VPC) deployments.

Appreciate the SOW draft — we’ll review and aim to provide feedback by Wed.

Vivek / Rishi — looping you both in after John’s note. Requested SE demo the week of May 24 (they asked specifically for code-level SDK integration, function-calling examples, streaming, and a re-ranking demo using embeddings).

Proposed assignments:
- Vivek: lead the SE demo. Please prepare:
  - Short SDK integration example (JS + Python snippets) showing streaming + function calls returning typed JSON (schema enforcement)
  - Live re-ranking demo: embedding generation -> ANN lookup -> lightweight neural reranker (we can use a small test corpus)
  - Notes on expected throughput and latency for a Dedicated pool sized for Acme’s initial pilot (we’ll use their traffic numbers when they share SSRs).

- Rishi: prepare an initial pricing/commitment estimate for a 3-month pilot on Dedicated capacity, plus an option for Private (VPC) deployment. Include typical SLAs and any onboarding professional services fees.

Lauren: please prepare CS onboarding checklist and pilot success metrics we should propose to Acme (evaluation prompts, quality thresholds, telemetry to capture).

Timeline: can we have a draft demo plan + slides by May 19 so Marissa can sync with John & Sarah and lock the May 24 slot? Also want a priced SOW draft by May 21.

Let me know if anything else is needed — I included the integration diagram and SOW draft for reference.

—
Marissa
